gui.insaneae.quantum_cpu.return_inventor: Return Inventory (items handed back to the network)
item.insaneae.task_fusion_card.tooltip: One bulk craft counts as a single co-processor operation
block.insaneae.insane_interface.desc:
Stocks up to 2,147,483,647 of each in 81 slots.
Amounts too large for a slot go straight into the ME network, so long-sized transfers are not truncated.
gui.insaneae.insane_interface.set_amount: Set amount to stock (enable, then click a config slot)
gui.insaneae.insane_interface.pull_mode_:
Pull mode: enabled
Moves the contents of adjacent inventories into the ME network every tick
(unlike pushing, not limited to one stack per tick)
block.insaneae.insane_pattern_provider.d:
A pattern provider with 1620 pattern slots (30 pages).
Put processing patterns here — the Quantum CPU no longer accepts them.
insaneae.desc.solar_panel:
Generates up to %s AE/t from skylight.
Output follows the light right above it, so it drops at night and under cover.
block.insaneae.quantum_cpu.desc:
Can hold 1620 recipes and crafts up to 9223 quadrillion per tick.
Only accepts patterns it can craft itself — put processing patterns in the Insane Pattern Provider.
block.insaneae.improved_charger.desc: Charges and transforms up to 64 items at once, in a single tick.
item.insaneae.creative_cell.desc:
Provides an endless supply of whatever it is configured with.
Reports 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 of each - a Creative Cell only reports 2,147,483,647.
